content: सांपराय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) .²1 Relating to war, warlike. .²2 Relating to the other world, future. .{@-यः, -यम्@} .²1 Conflict, contention. .²2 Future life, the future; योगिनां सांपरायविधिमनुशिक्षयन् <ls>Bhāg. 5. 6. 6</ls>. .²3 The means of attaining the future world. .²4 Inquiry into the future; यस्य प्रमाणं भृगवः सांपराये <ls>Bhāg. 8. 19. 2</ls>. .²5 Inquiry, investigation. .²6 Uncertainty. .²7 A helper; <ls>Mb. 1. 3. 58</ls>. .²8 Need, distress, calamity; उक्तपूर्वं कुतो राजन् सांपराये स वक्ष्यति <ls>Mb. 1. 48. 11</ls>.
